harness.scene: The terrain is a 3D scan of a real desert canyon (a dry riverbed): rock walls, boulders and uneven ground, open to the sky. A flight ceiling (an altitude geofence) acts like a roof, so the drone cannot climb over the canyon walls.

review.detail: Review decision “approved”: Canyon preview approved on 2026-11-15.

scale.detail: Not measured. Recorded so far: Scene units x8, treated as metres: chosen by eye with a correctly scaled drone in a lower channel; there the narrowest pinch is about 6 m. The collider's native 0.05-unit voxels become 0.4 m, so the grid cell is 0.4. The crop top (y = 20, the earlier 2.5-unit ceiling x8) is the altitude limit that seals the plateaus. Not independently calibrated. (Shown for information; not enforced.)

passage.detail: Narrowest gap on the flight graph: 0.92 m (the drone is 0.50 m wide) at [81.9, 16.1, -39.5].

alignment.detail: 93.6% of 2565 sampled surface cells of the scan's own collider (the altitude fence and sealed hollows excluded) have scan points within 0.80 m (needs 90%).

coverage.detail: 98.1% of 214 waypoints have captured scan ground below them (needs 90%). Captured means at least 5 scan points within 2 m (5% of this scan's median, 28). 2 waypoints sit over ground with no scan surface within 2.5 m (ground we sealed).

routes.detail: 108 routes (12 train, 24 dev, 24 heldout, 48 test) match sim/scenarios/reach-canyon5b.json.

between.detail: Reactive avoider 66.7%, between straight 29.2% and planner 100%.

missions-search.detail: Sets match sim/scenarios/mission-canyon5b-search.json. Each target used once. Oracle completed 4 of 4 development missions.
